[[File:Joe Helfrich DecipherCon 2000 FC.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Joe Helfrich. Still: Player's Council.]]
'''Joe Helfrich''' was one of the first [[Rules Advocate|Player Advocates for Rules Support]], named with Greg Anderson in Warren Holland's announcement of 25 January 2002.<ref name="pc1" /> He was also a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Bravo 15 from Westminster, Co.<ref name="smlist" />

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support).

== Jedi Knights TCG ==
Helfrich playtested the [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] (2001).<ref name="jkrules">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010820125115/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt Internet Archive]</ref>

== Radio Free Decipher (2002) ==
On ''[[Radio Free Decipher]]'' Broadcast 112 (25 January 2002), [[Scott Gaeta]] and host [[Kyle Heuer]] described Helfrich as a "huge rules guy" with a strong presence on the discussion lists. They called him "widely known as one of the guys that knows more about the game than even our designers".<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=docK2vpQWUI&t=943s Broadcast 112 - Radio Free Decipher (25 January, 2002): Scott Gaeta on the SWCCG PC], Player's Council, YouTube (uploaded 13 May 2022), at 15:43. Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-docK2vpQWUI Internet Archive]. Transcript: [[Radio Free Decipher/Episode 112 transcript]].</ref>
